display_long_description:
Highstreet: Calamity – VR Roguelike Arena Combat in a Manic Metaverse

Protect the FOMO DUCKS! Highstreet: Calamity is a fast-paced, class-based VR roguelike brawler set in Solera, a chaotic world where talking ducks run businesses, pelicans have strong opinions, and monster portals are “just an average Tuesday.”

In Highstreet City’s Central Gardens, reality is unraveling. Portals in The Greenhouse unleash bizarre enemies—from rampaging robots to malicious mushrooms. It’s up to you and your squad to fight back.

Choose your class, grab your gear, and jump into solo or co-op VR combat. Face procedurally generated waves, wild bosses, and endless chaos. Build combos, evolve your skills, and define your play style with multiple classes.

Features:

• Hands-on VR roguelike combat

• Deep progression with gear upgrades and branching skill paths

• Solo or co-op multiplayer

• Waves of unpredictable enemies, bosses, and monster mayhem

• Social lobby with friends and fun

• Rich lore and a vibrant metaverse-MMO world

Highstreet: Calamity is your first step into Solera, full of adventure, commerce, mystery, and quirky characters (including Benjamin the duck). Frequent updates keep the chaos fresh.

Pick a class. Smash the chaos. Save the ducks.
